verdict.rationale: The docs show an official Python-style client covering parse (`client.parse.run`, including chunking config) and async jobs (`client.parse.run_job()` returning a job ID). The minimal quickstart call suggests sensible defaults, and a published OpenAPI spec supports SDK generation. However, nothing in the evidence shows a TypeScript SDK, typed models, or SDK coverage of extract. Missing for 10: evidence of an official TypeScript SDK, explicit typing (type hints or TS types), SDK examples for extract and the other endpoints, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
